register.name: Register of persons placing packaged goods on the market (MOEW / ExEA)
register.operator: Ministry of Environment and Water (MOEW) / Executive Environment Agency (ExEA)
register.notes: MOEW packaging page fetched 2026-08-16 (Bulgarian): producers comply either by joining a recovery organisation (Ecopack, Bulecopack) or fulfilling obligations individually (product fee to the state/PUDOOS). Public registers of recovery organisations and obligated persons exist under MOEW. The earlier candidate portal nwms.eea.government.bg returned only an 'IIS Windows Server' placeholder — not the register; corrected here. Qualified e-signature is required for e-registration.

pro.ecoModulation: Aluminium (0.152) and PET bottles ≤3L (0.151) dearest; steel cheapest metal (0.066). Volume discounts for annual quantities over 10 tonnes.

extraTaxes.name: Продуктова такса (product fee to PUDOOS)
extraTaxes.summary: Companies that do NOT join a recovery organisation must instead pay a product fee to the state enterprise PUDOOS. Joining a recovery organisation (Ecopack/Bulecopack) is the alternative that fulfils EPR without the state fee.

notes: Rates from Ecopack Bulgaria's official member prices page, base rates effective 01.01.2026 (fetched 2026-08-16, EUR/kg excl. VAT): paper/cardboard 0.118, other plastics 0.125 (PET bottles ≤3L 0.151), glass 0.144, steel 0.066 (shown as 'metal'; aluminium 0.152), wood 0.069. Minimum annual fee €80 per obligated party. Composite left null (no separate row). Bulecopack is the second recovery organisation.
